exposure: Primigravida with Inductions or caesarean section before labour
cohort: 3400 women who gave birth at JPMC between January 1st and June 30th, 2018
finding: The study found a cesarean section rate of 36.5% with the majority being performed for repeat cesarean section (Robson's Group 5).
mod_finding: The most common indication for cesarean section was repeat cesarean section (Group 5), followed by fetal distress and first-time mothers induced or undergoing cesarean before labor.
